facts.statement: Some researchers debate whether Aorun should be classified as a carnosaurian rather than a coelurosaurian.
facts.quote: though some researchers consider it to be a carnosaurian instead.

facts.statement: Researchers initially found an exposed leg bone on the surface before digging up the skull underneath.
facts.quote: They originally spotted a portion of a leg bone exposed on the surface, and when they dug it up, they found the skull underneath.

facts.statement: The genus name Aorun is derived from the Chinese mythical deity Ao Run, the Dragon King of the West Sea.
facts.quote: The generic name is derived from Mandarin Chinese and is actually a shortened masculine name of Ao Run, who is the Chinese mythical deity, the Dragon King of the West Sea in the epic Journey to the West.

facts.statement: The species name zhaoi honors Professor Zhao Xijin, who led expeditions to the Junggar Basin.
facts.quote: The specific name honours Professor Zhao Xijin, who led several important vertebrate paleontological expeditions to the Junggar Basin.

facts.statement: Aorun is a monotypic genus containing only the species Aorun zhaoi.
facts.quote: Aorun zhaoi is the only species under the genus, which thus is monotypic.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen includes a skull, lower jaws, vertebrae, a left ulna and hand, and parts of the legs and pubis.
facts.quote: The holotype, IVPP V15709, consists of a skull, the lower jaws, a neck vertebra, a dorsal vertebra, three tail vertebrae, the left ulna and hand, the lower ends of both pubes and both lower legs.

facts.statement: The skull contains a nearly complete scleral ring made of overlapping ossicles in the right eye socket.
facts.quote: The right orbit contains a nearly complete scleral ring which is composed of overlapping ossicles.

facts.statement: The teeth lack serrations or have very fine serrations of about 10 per millimeter only on the distal edges of some teeth.
facts.quote: The teeth are distinctive, because they have no serrations (in the premaxillary and in some dentary teeth), or bear very fine serrations (~10/mm) only on the distal carinae (maxillary teeth and some dentary teeth).

facts.statement: The type specimen is a juvenile measuring about 1 meter long and weighing approximately 1.5 kilograms.
facts.quote: The type specimen is a juvenile individual and measures about 1 m (3.3 ft) long, weighing about 1.5 kilograms (3.3 lbs).

facts.statement: Histological analysis suggests the holotype specimen was at most one year old and was not a perinate.
facts.quote: Choiniere et al. (2013) noted that based on a histological analysis of its femur and tibia and other characteristics of the holotype, this specimen of Aorun is at most one year old, and is clearly not a perinate.

facts.statement: The hand claws are distinct, with a large curved thumb claw and two smaller claws with straight undersides.
facts.quote: The claws of the hand are different from each other: the thumb claw is large and curved, but the other two claws are smaller and feature a straight underside.

facts.statement: Aorun is distinct from other theropods found in the same region, including Guanlong, Haplocheirus, Limusaurus, Monolophosaurus, Sinraptor, and Zuolong.
facts.quote: Aorun is different from other theropods discovered from the same region, such as Guanlong, Haplocheirus, Limusaurus, Monolophosaurus, Sinraptor and Zuolong.

facts.statement: Aorun features a shorter premaxillary body, a larger maxillary fenestra, a rodlike jugal, and closely spaced fine serrations on the tooth edges.
facts.quote: It has a shorter premaxillary body, but with a larger maxillary fenestra, a rodlike jugal, closely spaced fine serrations on the distal tooth carinae of the maxilla and dentary.

facts.statement: The original authors classified Aorun as a basal member of Coelurosauria and a member of Coeluridae.
facts.quote: The authors who described Aorun placed it in a basal position within Coelurosauria and a member of Coeluridae.

facts.statement: Researchers note that coding immature taxa as adults can artificially place them in basal positions in phylogenetic analyses.
facts.quote: Tykoski (2005) and others have demonstrated that when immature taxa, as is the case with this specimen, are coded as adults in a phylogenetic analysis, the immature taxa were recovered in artificially basal positions relative to adults of the same taxon.

facts.statement: Some analyses suggest Aorun may be a basal alvarezsaur, a classification that has been questioned by other researchers.
facts.quote: This assignment has been questioned. Analysis conducted by Kohta Kubo and colleagues with their description of the genus Jaculinykus in 2023 found it to be one the basalmost alvarezsaurs, being slightly more basal than the contemporary genus Haplocheirus.

facts.statement: A 2024 analysis by Cau recovered Aorun as a basal member of the superfamily Allosauroidea.
facts.quote: Cau (2024) recovered Aorun as a basal member of the superfamily Allosauroidea.

facts.statement: Radiometric dating places the fossil deposits at approximately 161.6 million years old, at the boundary of the Oxfordian and Callovian stages.
facts.quote: The specimen was collected by IVPP-GWU Field Expedition in 2006, in terrestrial red-brown siltstone that was shown by radiometric dating to have been deposited approximately 161.6 million years ago, at the boundary of the Oxfordian/Callovian stages of the Jurassic period.

facts.statement: The find is significant because coelurosaur fossils from the Jurassic period are rare.
facts.quote: This find is significant temporally, because coelurosaur fossils dating to the Jurassic are rare.

facts.statement: The paleoenvironment was warm but experienced a basin-wide seasonal dry climate.
facts.quote: The paleoenvironment of the Shishugou Formation was warm but had a basin-wide seasonal dry climate.

facts.statement: Aorun was likely a predator of small lizards and mammals.
facts.quote: Aorun was probably a predator of small lizards and mammals.

facts.statement: Aorun is the oldest known coelurosaur from the Shishugou Formation and the seventh theropod found there.
facts.quote: Aorun is the seventh theropod, and oldest coelurosaur known from the Shishugou Formation, which is considered one of the most phylogenetically and trophically diverse middle to late Jurassic theropod faunas.

facts.statement: Aorun is classified within the unranked group Coelurosauria.
facts.quote: unranked_familia: Coelurosauria

facts.statement: The species Aorun zhaoi was named and described in 2013 by Choiniere, Clark, Forster, Norell, Eberth, Erickson, Hongjun, and Xu.
facts.quote: La especie tipo Aorun zhaoi fue nombrada y descrita en 2013 por Choiniere, Clark, Catherine Forster, Mark Norell, David Eberth, Gregory Erickson, Chuc Hongjun en Xu Xing.

facts.statement: The genus name Aorun is derived from Mandarin Chinese and is the abbreviated masculine name of Ao Run, a mythical Chinese deity known as the Dragon King of the Western Sea.
facts.quote: El nombre del género se deriva del chino mandarín y en realidad es el nombre abreviado masculino de Ao Run, que es una deidad mítica china, el Rey dragón del mar occidental en la epopeya Viaje al Oeste.

facts.statement: The species name zhaoi honors Professor Zhao Xijin, who led several important paleontological expeditions in the Junggar Basin.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie honra al profesor Zhao Xijin, quien lideró varias importantes expediciones paleontológicas en la Cuenca Junggar.

facts.statement: Researchers originally spotted an exposed leg bone on the surface and found the skull underneath when they excavated it.
facts.quote: Ellos originalmente divisaron una parte de un hueso de la pata expuesto sobre la superficie, y cuando procedieron a excavarlo, encontraron el cráneo debajo de este.

facts.statement: Unlike Guanlong, Aorun lacks a midline crest on the premaxilla, nasals, and frontal bone.
facts.quote: Es diferente de Guanlong por carecer de una cresta medial en el premaxilar, nasales y en el hueso frontal.

facts.statement: Aorun also lacks high external nostrils and a short anterior maxillary process.
facts.quote: También carece de narinas externas altas, y un corto proceso maxilar anterior.

facts.statement: Aorun has a short premaxillary body with a larger maxillary fenestra, a bar-shaped jugal, and finely serrated edges on the distal carina of maxillary and dentary teeth.
facts.quote: Tiene un cuerpo premaxilar corto, pero con una mayor fenestra maxilar, un yugal en forma de barra, finos bordes aserrados apenas espaciadosen la carena distal del diente del maxilar y el dentario.

facts.statement: Aorun features elongated cervical vertebrae centers with two pneumatic foramina, a short neural spine that extends posteriorly in the dorsal vertebra, and a pubis shaft that is curved at the end.
facts.quote: Los centros de las vértebras cervicales son alargados con dos forámenes neumáticos, la espina neural es corta y se alarga en dirección posterior en la vértebra dorsal, y el eje púbico es curvado en el extremo.

facts.statement: The limb bones of Aorun are also significantly different from other species.
facts.quote: Los huesos de las extremidades son también significativamente diferentes.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Aorun zhaoi (IVPP V15709) was recovered from the Wucaiwan locality in the lower half of the Shishugou Formation in the Junggar Basin, Xinjiang, China.
facts.quote: Los restos del espécimen tipo de Aorun zhaoi IVPP V15709 fueron recuperados en la localidad de Wucaiwan, en la mitad inferior de la Formación Shishugou, en la Cuenca Junggar en Xinjiang, China.

facts.statement: The specimen was collected in 2006 from reddish-brown terrestrial mudstone dated to approximately 161.2 million years ago, at the boundary of the Oxfordian and Callovian stages of the Jurassic period.
facts.quote: El espécimen fue recolectado por una expedición de campo del IVPP-GWU en 2006, en una lutita terrestre pardo-rojiza, cuya edad fue establecida mediante la datación radiométrica en hace aproximadamente 161.2 millones de años, en el límite de las épocas del Oxfordiense y el Calloviense del péríodo Jurásico.

facts.statement: This discovery is significant because Jurassic coelurosaur fossils are rare.
facts.quote: Este hallazgo es significativo debido a que los fósiles de celurosaurios del Jurásico son raros.

facts.statement: The specimen is housed in the collection of the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology in Beijing, China.
facts.quote: Este espécimen se encuentra alojado en la colección del Instituto de Paleontología de Vertebrados y Paleoantropología en Pekín, China.

facts.statement: The paleoecosystem of the Shishugou Formation was warm and humid but had a dry season across the basin.
facts.quote: El paleoecosistema de la Formación Shishugou era cálido y húmedo pero tenía una temporada de clima seco a lo largo de la cuenca.

facts.statement: Aorun was likely a predator of small prey such as lizards and mammals.
facts.quote: Aorun probablemente era un depredador de pequeñas presas como lagartos y mamíferos.

facts.statement: Aorun is the seventh theropod and the oldest coelurosaur found in the Shishugou Formation, which is considered one of the most diverse theropod faunas of the mid to late Jurassic, both trophically and phylogenetically.
facts.quote: Aorun es el séptimo terópodo y el más antiguo celurosaurio encontrado en la Formación Shishugou, la cual es considerada una de las más diversas faunas de terópodos de mediados a finales del Jurásico tanto trófica como filogenéticamente.

facts.statement: The time range for Aorun is the Callovian stage, from 165.3 to 161.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Callovian to Callovian (165.3 to 161.5 million years ago)

facts.statement: The holotype IVPP V15709 consists of the skull, lower jaw, one cervical vertebra, one dorsal vertebra, three tail vertebrae, the left ulna and hand, the lower ends of both pubis bones, and the lower parts of the legs.
facts.quote: El holotipo, IVPP V15709, consiste del cráneo, la mandíbula inferior, una vértebra del cuello, una vértebra dorsal, tres vértebras de la cola, la ulna izquierda y la mano, los extremos inferiores de ambos pubis y la parte inferior de las patas.

facts.statement: In the skull, the right eye orbit contains an almost complete scleral ring composed of overlapping bonelets.
facts.quote: En el cráneo, la órbita ocular derecha contiene un anillo esclerótico casi completo que se compone de huesecillos solapados.

facts.statement: The estimated number of teeth is four in the premaxilla, twelve in the maxilla, and between twenty-five and thirty in the dentary.
facts.quote: Se estima que el número de dientes en el premaxilar es de cuatro, en el maxilar doce, y en el dentario entre veinticinco y treinta.

facts.statement: The teeth are unique; unlike other theropods, they lack serrated edges on the premaxilla and some dentary teeth, or have very fine serrations (approximately 10/mm) only on the distal carina of maxillary and some dentary teeth.
facts.quote: Los dientes son muy particulares, pues a diferencia de otros terópodos no tienen bordes aserrados en el premaxilar y en algunos dientes del dentario, o tienen sierras muy finas (∼10/mm) solo en la carena distal - dientes maxilares y algunos del dentario.

facts.statement: However, the authors noted that variability in dentition may be a consequence of its juvenile condition.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, los autores señalaron que la variabilidad en la dentición puede ser consecuencia de su condición juvenil.

facts.statement: Based on available skeletal remains, the specimen represents a small bipedal predator.
facts.quote: El espécimen, según se puede juzgar de los restos disponibles del esqueleto, representa a un pequeño depredador bípedo.

facts.statement: The holotype is a juvenile individual measuring about 1 meter in length and weighing approximately 1.5 kilograms.
facts.quote: El espécimen tipo es un individuo juvenil y mide cerca de 1 metro de longitud, y pesaría cerca de 1.5 kilogramos.

facts.statement: Choiniere et al. (2013) noted that based on histological analysis of the femur and tibia and other specimen characteristics, it was at most one year old and clearly not perinatal.
facts.quote: Choiniere et al. (2013) notaron que, basándose en el análisis histológico de su fémur y tibia y otras características del espécimen, este tendría como mucho un año de edad, y claramente no es perinatal.

facts.statement: Authors placed Aorun in a basal position within Coelurosauria, but in any case it is more derived than Tyrannosauroidea.
facts.quote: Los autores situaron a Aorun en una posición basal en Coelurosauria, pero en cualquier caso es más derivado que los Tyrannosauroidea.

facts.statement: It is possible that Aorun is a member of Coeluridae, which is the most basal clade of Maniraptora.
facts.quote: Es posible que sea un miembro de Coeluridae que es el clado más basal de Maniraptora.

facts.statement: The placement of Aorun in this position is due to the lack of synapomorphies that could provide evidence of affinity with more derived coelurosaurs.
facts.quote: La asignación de Aorun en esta posición se debe a la carencia de sinapomorfias que pudieran proveer evidencia de una afinidad con celurosaurios más derivados.

facts.statement: It should be noted that Tykoski (2005) and others have shown that taxa based on immature specimens (like this one) are coded as adults in phylogenetic analysis and appear artificially in primitive positions compared to adults of the same taxon.
facts.quote: Debe señalarse que Tykoski (2005) y otros han mostrado que los taxones basados en ejemplares inmaduros (como es el caso de este espécimen) son codificados como adultos en un análisis filogenético, aparecen artificialmente en posiciones primitivas en comparación a los adultos del mismo taxón.

facts.statement: The parent group listed for Aorun in the Paleobiology Database is Alvarezsauria.
facts.quote: Parent group: Alvarezsauria

facts.statement: Aorun is classified under the class Reptilia.
facts.quote: Class: Reptilia

facts.statement: In the depression of the cranial opening, the antorbital fenestra, there is a second opening in front, the maxillary fenestra, which occupies most of this depression.
facts.quote: En la depresión de la abertura craneal, la fenestra antorbitalis, al frente hay una segunda abertura, la fenestra maxillaris, que ocupa la mayor parte de esta depresión.

facts.statement: Teeth in the maxilla had denticles only on their posterior edges, which are very small and point toward the tips of the teeth.
facts.quote: Los dientes en el maxilar tenían dentículos solo en sus bordes posteriorews que son muy pequeños y se dirigen hacia la punta de los dientes.

facts.statement: Cervical vertebrae are moderately opisthocoelous: with centers convex in the front and concave in the back.
facts.quote: Las vértebras cervicales son medianamente opistocelosas: con los centros convexos en el frente y cóncavos en la parte posterior.

facts.statement: Hand claws differ from each other: the thumb claw is large and curved, but the others are small and have a straight lower edge.
facts.quote: Las garras de la mano son diferentes entre sí: la garra del pulgar es grande y curva, pero las otras son pequeñas y tienen un borde inferior recto.

facts.statement: The tibia has only a high and narrow groove on its front outer side that functioned as contact with the top of the astragalus.
facts.quote: La tibia tiene en su lado externo frontal solo un surco alto y estrecho que funcionaba como contacto con la parte superior del astrágalo.

facts.statement: This ascending process, however, although certainly positioned on the outer side, is low.
facts.quote: Este processus ascendens sin embargo, aunque ciertamente posicionado en el lado externo, es bajo.
